builds.title: Charcoal road keeper, Barbarian 2
traits: Proficiency +2. Strength save +5 and Constitution save +5. Barbarian Unarmored Defense is 10 + 2 Dexterity + 3 Constitution. Natural Armor gives AC 14 as a separate alternative. HP starts at 15 and gains 10 at 2nd level.
Barbarian supplies Nature and Perception. Outlander supplies Athletics, Survival, Sylvan, and Wanderer. Keen Smell grants advantage on smell-based Perception checks. Carries no gear.
Danger Sense gives advantage on Dexterity saves against visible effects while the bear is free of blindness, deafness, and incapacitation.
actions: Bite or claws. Strength-based unarmed strike +5, reach 5 ft. Deals 1d8+3 piercing or slashing, respectively. Add 2 while raging.
Reckless Attack. Choose on the first attack of your turn. Strength-based melee weapon attacks gain advantage for that turn. Until your next turn, attacks against you also gain advantage.

Rage. Bonus action, twice per long rest, up to 1 minute. Advantage on Strength checks and saves, resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, and +2 damage on Strength-based melee weapon attacks. Ends early on unconsciousness or if a turn ends without attacking a hostile creature or taking damage since the previous turn. Can also end it with a bonus action.
builds.tactics: Pitchfern circles uphill on the bank. If cutting in front of a runaway cart fails, he climbs above the bend and warns the crew coming the other way.

builds.title: Orchard boundary keeper, Fighter 2
traits: Proficiency +2. Strength save +5 and Constitution save +3. Unarmored AC 11 + 2 Dexterity. HP starts at 11 and gains 7 at 2nd level.

Fighter supplies Animal Handling, Perception, and the Defense fighting style. Defense requires worn armor, so it gives no bonus on this unarmored patrol. Outlander supplies Athletics, Survival, Dwarvish, and Wanderer.
actions: Tusk. Strength-based unarmed strike +5, reach 5 ft., 1d6+3 slashing.
Charge. Once per turn add 1d6 slashing when Gravelroot moves 15 ft. or more toward a creature and hits it with a tusk attack.
Relentless. Drop to 1 HP instead of 0 HP if reduced to 0 HP without dying outright. Recharges on a long rest.
Second Wind. Bonus action to regain 1d10+2 HP. Recharges on a short or long rest.
Action Surge. Take one extra action on the current turn. Recharges on a short or long rest. Charge still applies only once that turn.
builds.tactics: Gravelroot calls from behind a dry wall. If anyone tries to cross, she runs the length of the wall to charge through the gap.

builds.title: Salt road messenger, Monk 2
traits: Proficiency +2. Strength save +3 and Dexterity save +4. Unarmored Defense is 10 + 2 Dexterity + 2 Wisdom. HP starts at 10 and gains 7 at 2nd level.

Monk supplies History and Insight. Rillglass trained with leatherworker's tools but cannot operate them. Outlander supplies Athletics, Survival, Terran, and Wanderer. Unarmored Movement raises the species' 50-ft. walk speed to 60 ft.
Two ki points. Regains them on a short or long rest that includes at least 30 minutes of meditation. Ki save DC 12.
actions: Bite. Martial Arts allows a Dexterity-based unarmed strike at +4, reach 5 ft., 1d4+2 slashing.
Martial Arts. After the Attack action with an unarmed strike, take a bonus action for one conventional kick at +4 for 1d4+2 bludgeoning. This uses Kamstra's bonus-strike rule.
Flurry of Blows. Immediately after the Attack action, spend 1 ki point and the bonus action to make two conventional kicks, each +4 for 1d4+2 bludgeoning.

Patient Defense or Step of the Wind. Spend 1 ki point and the bonus action to Dodge with Patient Defense, or to Disengage or Dash with Step of the Wind. Step of the Wind doubles jump distance that turn.
builds.tactics: Rillglass uses Step of the Wind to Disengage from a crowd. If blocked, she kicks once and chooses Patient Defense while waiting for someone to move.

builds.title: Eaves runner, Rogue 2
traits: Proficiency +2. Dexterity save +5 and Intelligence save +3. Unarmored AC 10 + 3 Dexterity. HP starts at 10 and gains 7 at 2nd level. No gear.

Rogue supplies Acrobatics, Insight, Investigation, and Perception. Urchin supplies Sleight of Hand, Stealth, and City Secrets. Expertise doubles proficiency in Perception and Stealth. Pinwhisker cannot use the hand-dependent tools from his training.
actions: Bite. Dexterity-based unarmed strike +5, reach 5 ft., 1d4+3 slashing. Counts as a finesse weapon for Sneak Attack.

Sneak Attack. Once per turn on a bite hit, add 1d6 with advantage. It also applies without advantage when a non-incapacitated enemy of the target is within 5 ft. of it and Pinwhisker lacks disadvantage.
Cunning Action. Use a bonus action to Dash, Disengage, or attempt to Hide.
builds.tactics: Pinwhisker waits under the eaves until an accomplice distracts a pursuer. After biting, he uses Cunning Action to Disengage before retreating up the wall.

builds.title: Grain tunnel keeper, Barbarian 1
traits: Proficiency +2. Strength save +5 and Constitution save +3. Unarmored Defense is 10 + 2 Dexterity + 1 Constitution. Carries no gear.
Barbarian supplies Nature and Perception. Outlander supplies Athletics, Survival, Dwarvish, and Wanderer.
actions: Bite or constrict. Strength-based unarmed strike +5, reach 5 ft. Deals 1d8+3 slashing for a bite or bludgeoning for constrict. Add 2 while raging.

Coil grip. After a constrict hit with the Attack action, spend a bonus action to grapple the target if within reach and no larger than Large. Athletics +5 contests its choice of Athletics or Acrobatics. Rage gives Loamcoil advantage. An incapacitated target within those limits is grabbed automatically.

Rage. Bonus action, twice per long rest, up to 1 minute. Advantage on Strength checks and saves, resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, and +2 damage on Strength-based melee weapon attacks. Ends early on unconsciousness or if a turn ends without attacking a hostile creature or taking damage since the previous turn. Can also end it with a bonus action.
builds.tactics: Loamcoil waits just inside the unlit grain tunnel, then coils around the first intruder that passes the chalk line. He asks for a name before letting go.

concepts.name: Pitchfern
concepts.role: Keeps the downhill charcoal road clear for loaded carts.
concepts.motive: Find where the fourth cart went after its axle snapped.
concepts.hook: Pitchfern followed the scent of pine tar downhill until the wheel marks split apart.

concepts.name: Gravelroot
concepts.role: Patrols the old wall between two orchards.
concepts.motive: Keep the fruit pickers away from the sinkhole by the gate.
concepts.hook: A picker's ladder lies across the hole. Gravelroot heard someone move it from below.

concepts.name: Rillglass
concepts.role: Carries spoken messages between wells on the salt road.
concepts.motive: Find which well keeper keeps answering a question she never asked.
concepts.hook: For three crossings, Rillglass has been told the same traveler arrived the previous evening.

concepts.name: Pinwhisker
concepts.role: Listens from the rafters above a shipping office.
concepts.motive: Find the shipper who has been throwing food to the alley cats since winter.
concepts.hook: Pinwhisker heard two clerks agree to sign the name of a person they buried last week.

concepts.name: Loamcoil
concepts.role: Keeps watch underneath a walled granary.
concepts.motive: Find where the missing grain sacks went.
concepts.hook: There is a fresh trail of grain dust in a wall gap too narrow for the carts.
